title: Arbitrium
description: Modpack for Taxphobia's minecraft server Arbitrium
body:
# Arbitrium

> *The official client modpack for **Taxphobia Vanilla Season 11**.*

Arbitrium is built for one thing: getting out of your way. No visual overhauls, no gameplay changes just a heavily optimized client that makes Minecraft run the way it should have from the start. Faster load times, higher frame rates, smoother chunk rendering, and a handful of essential quality-of-life fixes that every player needs without even knowing it.

If you're joining the server, this is your baseline.

---

## Available versions

| Version | Description |
|:--------:|-------------|
| **Arbitrium** | ✅ Base performance |
| **Arbitrium+** | Adds QoL mods for a better experience |
| **Arbitrium Q+** | Adds visual and graphic enhancements |

---

## What's inside

<details>
<summary>⚡ Performance</summary>

A complete replacement of Minecraft's rendering pipeline, memory management, and network stack. Built around **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)** with **[Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra)** and **[Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options)**, supported by **[FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferritecore)**, **[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)**, **[ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix)**, **[ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)**, **[Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling)**, **[ScalableLux](https://modrinth.com/mod/scalablelux)**, **[Krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton)**, **[LazyDFU](https://modrinth.com/mod/lazydfu)**, **[Smooth Boot](https://modrinth.com/mod/smoothboot-fabric)**, **[BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations)** and **[Super Fast Math](https://modrinth.com/mod/superfastmath)**.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🔧 Essential QoL</summary>

A minimal set of client-side fixes and utilities: **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)**, **[More Chat History](https://modrinth.com/mod/morechathistory)**, **[Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify)**, **[Fast IP Ping](https://modrinth.com/mod/fast-ip-ping)**, **[Packet Fixer](https://modrinth.com/mod/packet-fixer)**, **[Cubes Without Borders](https://modrinth.com/mod/cubes-without-borders)**, **[EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)**, **[ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)** and **[Ixeris](https://modrinth.com/mod/ixeris)**.

</details>
